create_jamesbond_player: create a JamesBond player instance with zero ammunition and zero consecutive protect count
update_jamesbond_action: update a JamesBond player state by calling update_with_action with fire protect or reload
get_jamesbond_state: get the current ammunition and consecutive protect tuple from a JamesBond player using get_state
create_doubleoseven_env: create a DoubleOSeven multi-agent gym environment with two JamesBond players and optional verbose mode
run_doubleoseven_step: run a step on the DoubleOSeven env with an action dict mapping player names to action indices
